up: Show the first 200 metabolism records for CYP2C19. Include substrate canonical SMILES and compound names, metabolism conversion description, pathway key, and organism.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  COALESCE(cr.compound_name, md.pref_name) AS compound_name,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key,
  m.organism
FROM metabolism m
JOIN target_dictionary td ON m.enzyme_tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_records cr ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE td.pref_name = 'CYP2C19'
LIMIT 200;
